items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution and is being actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this zero-day.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento that could allow an attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction. Exploitation attempts were detected in August 2026, and it was added to the CISA KEV on September 25, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, potentially leading to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using a polyglot technique. A fix was released in Magento 2.4.9.
